does.text: Only queues: appends (entity, guid, name) to the system's own request array, and logs an assert if the same entity is queued twice in one frame. No component is touched.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll (Toolkit build) pseudo-code, HitProxySystem::RequestAttachHitProxyAfterInit at +0x3BFA20, read whole (42 lines)

does.text: Two passes. First, for each queued after-init request: if the entity already has esv::hit::AttachProxyAfterInitRequestComponent it is skipped; otherwise, if an unnamed helper (FUN_1803bbf20, not read) says no, the guid is resolved to an entity handle through the uuid mapping; when that resolves, the attach is requested immediately through RequestAttachHitProxy, and when it does not resolve, AttachProxyAfterInitRequestComponent (0x18 bytes: guid plus name) is added to the entity by a deferred AddComponent so the request survives until later. Second, for every entity that currently has the component (the query is a spec naming it), the stored guid is resolved again; once it resolves the request is made and the component is removed from the entity.
